description: Photograph of a Los Angeles County Registrar-Recorder/County Clerk voter notification card held in hand, addressed to voters registered with No Party Preference ahead of the March 2020 California presidential primary. It lays out three options: keep a non-partisan ballot (no action), request a crossover ballot from the American Independent, Democratic or Libertarian parties by December 20 2019, or change party affiliation by February 17 2020 to receive a Green, Peace & Freedom or Republican ballot. Signed by Dean C. Logan, Registrar-Recorder/County Clerk; county seal at lower right.
text: Voter:. re currently registered to vote with No Party Preference (non-partisan). If you want your Vote By Mail ballot for the March. Primary Election to include candidates for President, you must notify our office. Your options depend on the party whose. didates you want on your ballot.. HAT TO DO NEXT:. To receive a No Party Preference ballot without the Presidential contest:. No action is required. To request a ballot for these parties:. American Independent. Democratic. Libertarian. Complete the request form on the back of this card and return it by. Friday, December 20, 2019. To receive a ballot for these parties. Green. Peace & Freedom. Republican. You must change your party affiliation. Monday, February 17, 2020. (See options at lavote.net). If you have any questions, please contact us at (800) 815-2666, Option 2. Additional voting information and resources are also available online at www.lavote.net.. Sincerely,. DEAN C. LOGAN. Registrar-Recorder/County Clerk. URN ADDRESS
flags: Left and right edges of the card are cropped; a few words at the margins are cut off

description: Screenshot of Q drop #436, posted December 22 2017 on 8chan (tripcode !UW.yye1fxo, post No.151134). Headed ONE OF TWENTY TWO and [DNC BREACH / DOSSIER], it is a shorthand list of abbreviations and initials the drop links to the DNC breach and Steele dossier — e.g. [SR], [WL], HUSSEIN, HRC, GOOG, CROWDSTRIKE, STEELE, PODESTA, [FISA 2] — ending with the claim that US intelligence legally spied on a presidential candidate, president-elect, Republican Congress members, senators and friendly news outlets. The content is the drop’s own claim, presented in Q’s cryptic list style.

description: Annotated side-by-side comparison graphic (aggregator-site cards) pairing a Donald Trump tweet of January 21 2020 reading READ THE TRANSCRIPTS! (timestamped 11:08:04 AM) with Q drop #3779 posted the same day at 11:07:34 AM, which claims the impeachment effort is not about removing POTUS but about self-protection from prosecution. Red boxes highlight the two timestamps and red lines converge on the caption 30-second delta - Q posted first, asserting the near-simultaneous timing as evidence of a Q-Trump connection.

description: Dramatic black-and-white photograph of President Donald Trump standing in shadow between two U.S. Marine Corps sentries in dress blue uniforms with white peaked covers and medals. The Marines flank the frame in sharp focus while Trump, in suit and dark tie with a flag lapel pin, stands centered behind them against a black background; a thin vertical rail is blurred in the foreground. High-contrast lighting gives the image a stylized, portrait-like quality often shared as a pro-Trump/military motif.
flags: The two Marines are not identified and remain anonymous service members
